np_properties.TOR (.onion): The .onion address IS the identity. No DNS. No certificate authority. Pure crypto routing.
np_properties.NOSTR (federated social): Each relay independently verifies. No central authority. Pure crypto.
np_properties.GIT (source code): Every commit is a signed statement. Git history IS the immutable ledger.
np_properties.DNS (inbound blackholes): DNS is the FIRST gate. Before any packet arrives, DNS decides: allow or sinkhole.
np_properties.SMTP (email): Ancient protocol. Still works. The organism can receive mail.
np_properties.LAN (local radiation): No internet needed. The organism radiates to its own body.

equation: O/inf = pi. Each surface adds a digit. The dark web is the digit you can't see.
